display_long_description:
Immerse yourself in Florence as if you were truly there. This VR experience places you inside the iconic Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, where you can explore its monumental spaces freely. Marvel at Brunelleschi’s magnificent dome, painted with Vasari and Zuccari’s fresco “The Last Judgment,” and admire the intricate geometric marble floors. Feel the serenity and grandeur of this historic site as you take in every detail at your own pace, just as if you were physically present.

Descend into the Crypt of Santa Reparata, a quiet and reflective space filled with history. Discover the remains of the original church and ancient artifacts while experiencing the profound connection to Florence’s past. Back in the cathedral, take a moment to absorb the calm atmosphere before stepping outside to gaze at the facade and Giotto’s Bell Tower, all surrounded by the lively energy of the square.

Finally, stand before the Baptistery of San Giovanni and its renowned golden “Gates of Paradise.” Enter this sacred space and look up to the dazzling mosaic dome, where biblical stories unfold in shimmering gold and intricate detail. This is not a guided tour or a scripted documentary—this is your own personal journey, a chance to explore Florence in its most authentic form. No stress, no crowds, just the freedom to experience everything as if you were there.
